verdict.rationale: Devin ships a desktop app: its docs cover importing VS Code or Cursor settings and configuring themes, and the docs index lists a 100-page Desktop section. The docs also describe running independent tasks simultaneously and following Devin's work in an embedded IDE. However, nothing in the pack shows visual diff review or side-by-side sessions inside the desktop app itself. missing for 10: explicit visual diff review UI in the desktop app, side-by-side multi-session view in the desktop app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
